questions.question: A shopkeeper bought 120 articles at ₹45 each. He sold 80 at ₹60 each, 30 at ₹40 each, and the remaining at 20% loss on CP. What is his overall profit/loss percentage?
A trader marks goods 35% above CP and offers successive discounts of 10% and 8%. He still earns a profit of ₹756 per item. What is the CP?

Scenario:
A retailer buys fruits at ₹60/kg and sells at ₹75/kg. Due to spoilage, 20% of stock is wasted. What is the effective profit % on investment if he bought 100 kg?
A dishonest dealer uses a 920g weight instead of 1 kg and adulterates goods by mixing 15% impurity at zero cost, while claiming to sell at CP. What is his actual profit %?

Scenario:
A contractor has 20 workers who can build a wall in 12 days. After 4 days, 5 workers fall sick and leave. The client wants the wall done in the original 12-day window. How many extra workers must be hired on Day 5?
12 men complete a project in 18 days. After 6 days, 4 men leave. How many additional days beyond the original deadline will the project be delayed?
Pipe A fills a tank in 12 hours, B fills it in 18 hours, C empties it in 9 hours. All three open at 8:00 AM with tank initially 1/4 full. When will the tank be completely full?
A train 240m long passes a pole in 12s and a platform in 28s. A man on the platform takes 4s to cross the train when moving in opposite directions. What is the speed of the man (m/s)?

Two cities A and B are 360 km apart. A car leaves A at 7:00 AM at 60 km/h. A bus leaves B at 9:00 AM at 80 km/h toward A. A bird starts from A at 7:00 AM at 100 km/h and shuttles between car and bus until they meet. Total distance covered by the bird?
A boat covers 48 km upstream in 4 hours and 60 km downstream in 3 hours. How long does it take to cover 90 km in still water?

Scenario:
A family invests ₹1,20,000 in a fixed deposit at 8% per annum compounded annually for 2 years. Bank deducts 10% TDS on interest earned each year. What is the net amount received after 2 years?
The difference between compound interest (half-yearly) and simple interest on ₹8,000 at 10% per annum for 1.5 years is:

Average age of 40 students is 16 years. Including 5 teachers, average rises by 2 years. If 2 teachers with average age 42 are replaced by 2 others with average age 34, what is the new overall average?
A, B, C invest ₹5,000 for 12 months, ₹6,000 for 8 months, and ₹9,000 for 6 months respectively. Total profit is ₹1,23,000. Find C's share.
A number divided by 342 gives remainder 47. What is the remainder when the same number is divided by 18?
In a 3-candidate election, the winner gets 48%, second gets 33%, third gets the rest. Winner's margin over second is 3,600 votes. What is the total number of votes polled?

Scenario:
Riya produces 200 cupcakes daily at a total cost of ₹4,000. She sells 160 at ₹28 each; the remaining 40 go stale. She also pays ₹400 fixed daily overhead.
What is her daily net profit or loss?

Scenario:

Scenario:

II. No sharpener is a pencil.
III. Some pencils are not sharpeners.

Which conclusion(s) follow?

Statements:

2. All dancers are singers.
3. Some singers are musicians.

Conclusions:
I.  All actors are singers.
II. Some musicians are dancers.
III. Some actors are musicians.

Which conclusions definitely follow?
